notes: §2002:8.4.2.12.2 SR1 'Identifier-1 shall be of category alphanumeric or national.' with §2002:8.5.2.1 'An alphabetic data item may be specified wherever an elementary alphanumeric data item is permitted as an operand.': at --std 2002 SET PP TO ADDRESS OF PROGRAM NM over NM PIC A(8) VALUE 'NOSUCHPG' compiles (it drew COBOL2157 before kb/Work PB5615) and, GR4 'the value of the address-identifier is the predefined address NULL' for a program the runtime cannot locate, prints NULL. From 2014 the same source is refused (§2014:E.2 withdrew the sentence): pb5615-program-address-alphabetic-name-refused. The edition axis is EditionInfo.AlphabeticIsAlphanumeric (Year == 2002), read by ItemCategory.IsAlphanumericOrNational(Place, EditionInfo). retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/Procedure/Verbs/SetBinder.cs#BindProgramAddressOperand (kb/Work PB2314 split SetBinder into one binder per SET format family; the member moved, unchanged, to the family binder the record names in its place)
